topic: How to Remove Limescale From Faucets
notes: Treat finish compatibility as critical. A soft damp cloth and prompt drying are the safest baseline. Some manufacturers permit diluted vinegar for mineral deposits, but others warn against acids on certain finishes, so frame vinegar as manufacturer-dependent rather than universally safe. Rinse thoroughly after any approved cleaner and avoid abrasives, bleach-based cleaners and harsh acids unless explicitly allowed by the faucet manufacturer.
